  • Reports US considering shifting Gulf bases westward, including options in Israel. US Fifth Fleet facilities in Bahrain sustained earlier damage — logistic sensitivity remains.

Nuclear / IAEA

  • IAEA granted access under a US‑Iran understanding. IAEA seeks verification and hopes to begin inspections soon. Tactical: inspections reduce covert breakout risk if allowed to proceed.

International

🟢 Good News

  • IAEA access secured for inspections. Local Lebanon ceasefire renewed. Humanitarian aid offers reported from multiple regional states.
